page: Microsoft Azure DC24ds_v3 is a memory-optimized server instance belonging to the DDCSv3 family. It is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz, featuring 24 dedicated physical cores and 24 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The hardware configuration includes 192.0 GB of system memory, providing an 8.0 GB per core ratio. Local storage is bundled with a capacity of 1843 GB, and the instance is Premium Storage capable, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier for most compute and memory operations, though it demonstrates strong capabilities in specific workloads. The single-core Geekbench score is 1680.0, and the multi-core score reaches 15933.0. In data processing tasks, the server achieves a strong rating in image processing with a score of 15819.0 and a static web serving throughput of 43.73 GB/sec. Large block memory bandwidth registers at 163.72 GB/sec for read-only operations and 66.28 GB/sec for write operations.

For language model workloads, the server handles small 135M models efficiently, generating 296.4 tokens/sec in the strong tier. However, performance drops to a weak rating of 2.74 tokens/sec when executing text generation on large 70B models, highlighting a clear tradeoff for large-scale AI inference without dedicated GPU acceleration. Given its high memory-to-core ratio and local storage, this server is well-suited for database operations, memory-intensive applications, static web serving, and software compilation.
